wave3_gate.decision_reason: The bounded same-leaf review found no additional candidate family with a clear quality and depth benefit after the foundation cohort. Remaining safe headroom is retained; supported D2 gaps alone do not justify count-filling items where the underlying concept is already covered or the new item would repeat current reasoning.

wave4_gate.reason: No separate deficiency remained that justified another authoring wave.

stopping_decision.wave3_reason: Foundation targets are met for every authorable leaf. Remaining under-20 candidates do not justify more content after the bounded semantic-diversity and depth review; retain remaining headroom for later evidence-backed work.
stopping_decision.why_expansion_stopped: FOUNDATION_OBJECTIVES_MET for every authorable leaf; the one remaining raw under-10 leaf is the explicitly deferred mental-health-law leaf. The 21-question cohort added D2/D3/D4 coverage, and further Wave3 additions were deferred until marginal semantic diversity is reassessed.
